name: sandpile
title: sandpile
blurb: a live abelian sandpile automaton: drop chips on a grid, every cell holding four or more topples one into each neighbor, and the cascade always settles into the same self-similar fractal. seed it with a bluesky handle for a deterministic pile of your own. a daily-slot pass, the repo's physics-toy corner hadn't done cellular automata yet.
